definition: A medical examination required for some study permit, work permit and most permanent residence applicants, performed only by a panel physician authorised by Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada.
longform: Whether one is required depends on the applicant's country of residence and the type of application. It cannot be completed by any doctor — only a panel physician's exam is accepted.
